messages:
mika: Ran 36h validation for Starlane-13b with two quant profiles (int8 baseline, int6 optimized). Mixed workload: 8k longform QA, 6k multi-paragraph summarization, 4k short snippets. Posting compact score + routing idea.
mika: TL;DR: int6 reduces per-token cost by ~19%, improves median latency for short calls, but shows a modest drop in exact-match recall for multi-span longform QA (~4.2%). Short summarization and single-paragraph QA unaffected.
andre: sample sizes and cost math?
mika: totals: 18k samples. Unit economics (hosted pricing proxy): int8 = $0.0092 /k tokens, int6 = $0.00745 /k tokens -> ~19% savings. Median latency (hosted profile): int8 p50=470ms, int6 p50=420ms. p95 = int8 1020ms, int6 1045ms. Throughput improved ~9% on dedicated fleet.
tess: how are we scoring recall / robustness? any priming / chain-of-thought sensitivity?
mika: primary metric = span-exact match on our longform-answers set (subset L3). We also ran a priming sweep (0 to 5 examples) and found int6 degrades more with 4-5 shot chains where prompt length > 900 tokens. Looks like attention quantization noise on KV across many context windows.
nora: can you paste the scorecard?
mika: pasted below (csv-ish):

metric, int8, int6, delta
unit_cost($/k), 0.0092, 0.00745, -19%
p50_latency(ms), 470, 420, -11%
p95_latency(ms), 1020, 1045, +2.4%
longform_QA_exact(%), 81.5, 77.3, -4.2pp
throughput(tokens/s), 2100, 2290, +9%
kv_cache_hit(long), 0.66, 0.60, -6pp

andre: 4.2pp is borderline for doc QA product. Can we do hybrid routing by predicted output length or feature hint?
mika: my proposal: default remain int8. For low-risk short-answer and summarization (<250 expected output tokens), allow int6. Add two guards: (1) if prompt contains chain-of-thought markers or >3 examples -> force int8, (2) if estimated context concat length > 1k -> force int8.
tess: also suggest a priming-guard threshold: if examples_count >=3 and examples_total_tokens >600 -> force int8. Many product prompts include multi-example templates now.
nora: ops implications? any infra flags needed?
mika: ops-bot: please create canary ticket referencing this thread. For Dedicated we can enable larger batch sizes for int6 to amortize token cost — but need to watch memory pressure and KV eviction.
deploy-bot: Canary ticket created: ML-2048 (starlane-int6-routing) - 4300000300
andre: Monitoring plan: 48h canary, metrics to track: exact-match by slice, ROUGE/F1 for summarization, CTR uptick (product), unit cost delta, p95 latency delta. Alert if longform exact-match drops >2% vs baseline.
tess: I'll add an automated snapshot job to capture priming-sensitive examples during canary and run an immediate re-eval when drift detected.
mika: rollout plan: (1) implement SDK feature_hint field for routing (examples: {"feature":"summary","estimated_out":200}) (2) start 10% canary on short-summary traffic -> monitor 48h -> if stable expand to 50% then 100% for short-summary only. Doc-QA always routed to int8.
andre: product: update GTN SDK to expose feature_hint and default to conservative route. We'll add opt-in checkbox for customers who want cost-savings.
nora: follow-ups: add small A/B to measure user-visible metric (answer accuracy/CTR) after 2 weeks and then make final recommendation.
mika: attaching short runbook snippet in this thread and a CSV of failing examples. Ping me for the full dumps.
